memoryBuilder.verseText: God said: 'I am with you. I will keep you everywhere you go.'

sequence.prompt: What happened to Jacob? Put it in order.

items.label: He slept outside with a stone pillow
God came to him in a stairway dream

matches.prompt: Match each one to what they did.

pairs.right: Tricked his father and ran away
Was angry that his blessing was taken
Came to Jacob anyway and promised to stay

application.question: God came to Jacob when he least deserved it. When do you feel least like God would want you?
application.followUp: Jacob was a liar, alone, and it was his own fault — and that is exactly where God turned up. Grace means God comes anyway.
